attchmntText: Prime Securities Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.
voiceSummary: Prime Securities Limited reported unaudited consolidated financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. The Board of Directors approved the results on November 12, 2026. For the quarter ended September 30, 2026, the company reported a loss after tax of Rs. 384 lakhs, with basic earnings per share of Rs. 1.06. For the half year ended September 30, 2026, the loss after tax was Rs. 1,187 lakhs. The auditor's report noted an exceptional item of Rs. 2,795 lakhs related to a settlement claim. The report also highlighted that the associate company, Ark Neo Financial Services Private Limited, has a negative net worth and relies on support from the holding company. The auditor did not modify their conclusion regarding these matters.
